name: hebrew-rtl
description: Hebrew RTL display fix (visual bidi on terminals, direction isolates on rich surfaces) plus Hebrew output hygiene rules

terminalMode.title: Terminal Hebrew mode
terminalMode.description: visual: reorder Hebrew for terminals without bidi (VS Code, Windows Terminal). off: leave as is (GNOME Terminal, Konsole do bidi themselves).

richMode.title: Desktop/VS Code extension Hebrew mode
richMode.description: isolate: wrap Hebrew lines in RLM+RLI..PDI so mixed Hebrew/English keeps its order. off: leave as is.

textMarks.title: Direction marks in the stored text
textMarks.description: Adds RLM+RLI..PDI to Hebrew lines of your prompts and Claude's replies, for apps that draw the conversation themselves (Claude app, cloud sessions). Copied text carries the invisible marks.

promptRules.title: Hebrew output rules in system prompt
promptRules.description: Adds short rules telling the model how to write Hebrew that displays cleanly.
